about_the_game:
Welcome to Ronnie Park!

Ronnie Park” is an action-adventure game in which you must exterminate ghosts and protect the theme park within a time limit.

You play the role of “Lucy,” a young girl who works at “Ronnie Park,” and you are tasked with exterminating ghosts in the theme park at night.

The park must open in the morning, so the ghost extermination must be done during the night.

Get the job done efficiently and have a peaceful morning.

Ghost exterminator

First time working as a ghost exterminator?

Don't be afraid. Ghosts are not good with light, so you can easily repel them by shining a light on them.

Let's explore each room and exterminate ghosts by shining a light on them.

Just pay attention to the remaining battery power of the light. You need to charge it frequently before the battery runs out. While dodging the attacks of the attacking ghosts, find a route to defeat the ghosts efficiently and complete the job of exterminating ghosts within the time limit.

Collecting items

In addition to exterminating ghosts, you may be asked to collect items.

When you exterminate ghosts, they drop items, which you must pick up and carry to the collection box.

Items must be carried one at a time, so you must choose your route more carefully than usual.

Stage Attacks.

The park offers a variety of arcade games, a haunted house, and a circus.

As the stages progress, the number of ghosts increases and the difficulty level rises.

In order to complete the extermination of ghosts within the time limit, it is necessary to identify the characteristics of each stage and exterminate ghosts efficiently.

As you progress through the story, you will discover the source and purpose of the ghosts and bring peace to the park.

Unique Characters

Ronnie Park has many friends!

Enjoy talking with stuffed bears, vampires, werewolves ...... and other sexual characters.

Sometimes you may be asked to do something other than exterminating ghosts in order to solve your friends' problems.

Communicate with your friends to get the job done and lead the theme park in a better direction.
